# Clean-Room Reproduction

For scripts and automation outputs, prefer checks that approximate a fresh consumer.

## Fresh context when relevant

Re-run in a clean shell or temp workspace when ordering bugs or hidden globals are suspected.

## Determinism probes

If outputs drift, pin seeds, time, or locale only when the task allows and it explains variance.

## Dependency honesty

Declare external prerequisites discovered during verification so the next runner inherits truth.
